scenario: Series membership/frequency scan without a sample bound is a compile error under +nolinscan per LNLS.3.11. `contains(t.state, 5)` over a ring-buffer series with no `max_samples` cap scans the window — O(series depth), which grows with the fact stream — so it is a linear scan in series depth (LNLS.1.1). This is the series-cursor overload of `contains`, not the String substring `contains` of LNLS.3.10. The bounded form compiles (LNLS.3.11b.json).
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Int mutable

series Sensor.state (by: entity_id):
    contains sliding 10_s

rule trig:
    Sensor t where contains(t.state, 5)
->
    log info "x"
